description: LLM Pulse is an AI search and generative engine optimization platform that tracks how brands appear in AI-generated answers across products like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews. It measures mentions, citations, share of voice, sentiment, and related visibility data for brands and competitors.
summary: LLM Pulse exposes a REST API at `https://api.llmpulse.ai/api/v1` authenticated by Bearer API key, plus an OAuth-protected MCP server at `https://api.llmpulse.ai/api/v1/mcp` that supports self-onboarding OAuth 2.1 and also accepts Bearer API keys.
